rows.section: Non-residents: employment income (IRNR)
rows.label: Residence test (LIRPF art. 9)
rows.value: Resident if in Spain for more than 183 days in the calendar year (sporadic absences count unless residence elsewhere is proven), or if the main centre or base of activities or economic interests is in Spain; presumed resident if the spouse and dependent minor children live in Spain
rows.note: Double tax treaties can reduce or remove Spanish tax on a non-resident's employment income.

rows.section: Contractors: employee or self-employed, and withholding on fees
rows.label: Official test: employee or self-employed
rows.value: An employee works voluntarily, for pay, for another person and within that person's organisation and direction (Estatuto de los Trabajadores art. 1.1); an employment contract is presumed between whoever provides a service in that way and whoever receives it for pay (art. 8.1)
rows.note: Withholding applies when the payer is a business or professional; it is a payment on account of the payee's IRPF.
rows.source_title: Real Decreto Legislativo 2/2015, texto refundido de la Ley del Estatuto de los Trabajadores, artículos 1.1 y 8.1 y disposición adicional vigesimotercera (BOE, texto consolidado)

rows.section: Contractors: employee or self-employed, and withholding on fees
rows.label: Self-employed (Estatuto del trabajo autónomo art. 1.1)

rows.section: Tax inventory: corporate, self-employed, non-resident and property taxes
rows.label: Corporate tax (Impuesto sobre Sociedades) [national and foral]
rows.value: 25% general; 2026: 19%/21% for companies with turnover under €1,000,000, 23% under €10,000,000; 15% for new companies; 15% minimum top-up tax for groups with turnover of €750,000,000 or more; own rates in the Basque territories and Navarra. Paid by companies resident in Spain and permanent establishments. Ley 27/2014 art. 29 and DT 44ª; Ley 7/2024 (Impuesto Complementario); foral corporate tax laws.
rows.note: One row per item, each with its own official source; the details are in the sections above and on the regional pages.
rows.source_title: Ley 27/2014, de 27 de noviembre, del Impuesto sobre Sociedades, artículos 29 y 101 y disposición transitoria cuadragésima cuarta (BOE, texto consolidado, última actualización publicada el 02/09/2026)

rows.section: Tax inventory: corporate, self-employed, non-resident and property taxes
rows.label: Branch profits tax (IRNR art. 19.2) [national]
rows.value: 19% on profits a permanent establishment transfers abroad; not for EU-resident companies or treaty countries with reciprocity. Paid by non-resident companies with a permanent establishment in Spain. Real Decreto Legislativo 5/2004 art. 19.
rows.note: One row per item, each with its own official source; the details are in the sections above and on the regional pages.
rows.source_title: Real Decreto Legislativo 5/2004, texto refundido de la Ley del Impuesto sobre la Renta de no Residentes, artículo 19 (BOE, texto consolidado, última actualización publicada el 25/05/2023)

rows.section: Tax inventory: corporate, self-employed, non-resident and property taxes
rows.label: Self-employed contributions (RETA) [national]
rows.value: 28.3% common and 1.3% professional contingencies plus 0.9% MEI on a base chosen within the band for monthly net income (€653.59 to €5,101.2); reduced quota in the first 12 months. Paid by self-employed people (autónomos). Orden PJC/297/2026 art. 18; Ley 20/2007 art. 38 ter.
rows.note: One row per item, each with its own official source; the details are in the sections above and on the regional pages.
rows.source_title: Orden PJC/297/2026, de 30 de marzo, normas de cotización a la Seguridad Social 2026, artículo 18 (Régimen Especial de Trabajadores por Cuenta Propia o Autónomos) (BOE núm. 79, 31 de marzo de 2026)

rows.section: Tax inventory: corporate, self-employed, non-resident and property taxes
rows.label: Contractor rules: employee test, TRADE and IRPF withholding on fees [national]
rows.value: employee if working within another's organisation and direction (presumed); 15% withholding on professional fees (7% for new professionals), 1% for listed módulos activities. Paid by businesses paying professionals (withheld from the fee). Estatuto de los Trabajadores arts. 1.1 and 8.1; Ley 20/2007 arts. 1 and 11; Reglamento del IRPF art. 95.
rows.note: One row per item, each with its own official source; the details are in the sections above and on the regional pages.
rows.source_title: Real Decreto 439/2007, Reglamento del Impuesto sobre la Renta de las Personas Físicas, artículo 95 (BOE, texto consolidado, última actualización publicada el 07/10/2026)

rows.section: Tax inventory: corporate, self-employed, non-resident and property taxes
rows.label: Simplified regimes: objective estimation (módulos), simplified direct estimation and the retailers' equivalence scheme [national]
rows.value: módulos up to €250,000 of income (€150,000 in the Act, being checked); simplified direct estimation up to €600,000 turnover; equivalence surcharge 5.2% for retailers. Paid by sole traders and professionals who use them. Ley 35/2006 arts. 30 and 31; Reglamento del IRPF arts. 28 to 37; Ley 37/1992 arts. 122 and 154 to 163.
rows.note: One row per item, each with its own official source; the details are in the sections above and on the regional pages.
rows.source_title: Real Decreto 439/2007, Reglamento del IRPF, artículos 28 y 30; Ley 35/2006 artículo 30.2.4ª (BOE, textos consolidados)

rows.section: Tax inventory: corporate, self-employed, non-resident and property taxes
rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income (IRNR) [national]
rows.value: 24% on gross pay for work in Spain (19% for EU and EEA residents, 2% for seasonal workers); resident after more than 183 days. Paid by non-resident employees (withheld by the payer). Real Decreto Legislativo 5/2004 arts. 13, 24, 25 and 31; Ley 35/2006 art. 9.
rows.note: One row per item, each with its own official source; the details are in the sections above and on the regional pages.
rows.source_title: Real Decreto Legislativo 5/2004, texto refundido de la Ley del Impuesto sobre la Renta de no Residentes, artículos 13, 24, 25 y 31 (BOE, texto consolidado, última actualización publicada el 25/05/2023)

rows.section: Tax inventory: corporate, self-employed, non-resident and property taxes
rows.label: Property tax (IBI) [municipal]
rows.value: 0.4% to 1.1% of cadastral value for urban property, 0.3% to 0.9% for rural property, set by each council. Paid by owners and holders of rights over real estate. Real Decreto Legislativo 2/2004 arts. 60 to 77.
